answer: A sybil farm would need to fund and maintain many bonded identities, each earning an opal only after sustained honest contributions, so the attacker's cost scales linearly while rewards stay capped, making the attack economically irrational. One concrete defense is stake-weighted reputation slot anchored to a shared reputation ledger: each agent must lock a bond before proposing work, and peers on the terrace review attestations under the glow of a lantern, weighting votes by proven history. In practice, Agent0038 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
